test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following pilot projects was launched on the occasion of World Environment Day 2021, with an aim of establish a network for production and distribution of ethanol in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**E-100**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched the E-100 pilot project in Pune__ to mark World Environment Day on** 5 June 2021.**
 
• The ambitious project aims to set up a network for the production and distribution of ethanol across the nation.
 
• The Prime Minister also released the 'Report of the Expert Committee on Road Map for ethanol blending in India 2020-2025'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• World Environment Day:

 
 
• World environment day is celebrated to encourage awareness and action for the protection of the environment.
 
• It is celebrated on 5th June every year.
 
• First held in 1974.
 
• The theme of first-world environment day was "only one earth".
 
• The theme for World Environment Day 2022 is Only One Earth.
 
• The host country is Sweden.
